page.layout: One printed page. Title block centred at the top, then the opening of the Tractatus: a decorative woodcut initial at the left, a running text column with a marginal note at the right.

main_text.head: GERHARDI Von MASTRICHT FCti & Antecessoris HISTORIA JURIS ECCLESIASTICI & PONTIFICII, SEU De Ortu, Progressu, Incrementis, Collectionibus, Auctoribusque Juris Ecclesiastici, & Pontificii
TRACTATIO.
main_text.p: SERVATOR noster Jesus Christus perfecto negotio redemtionis noftrae, in coelum, Ecclesiae suae supremus Rex, abiturus, Apostolos suos, quos vivus elegerat, ad colligendam Ecclesiam Christianam per universum orbem, cum potestate docendi & scribendi misit. Hi fidei noftrae principia, modumque cultus, novo foederi congruum cum fideliter tradidissent, & sanguine doctas veritates plerique obsignantes, ad Patriam coelestem οἰκίαν illam ἀχωρη- [?]I. Origo & causa Conci-liorum

page.notes: The woodcut initial S is joined to the first word, which is printed in small capitals after it. The Greek words in the last lines are hard to read at this scan; the Greek on the last line is uncertain and marked [?]. The right margin note is printed in small type beside the first lines. The Greek catchword at the foot of the paragraph is a fragment, given as an uncertain reading. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
